question: Is the Phone number field on browserbase.com/sign-up mandatory for the Google sign-in path as well as the email path?
why: The sign-up page shows Google and an email-plus-phone-plus-password form; whether Google OAuth still asks for a phone is visible only after a sign-in flow, which the absolute rules forbid starting (no account creation). Recorded as any-phone because the visible email path asks for a phone number; the Google path is unverified: behind a sign-in.
